contexts.text: Rivers of honey and butter () = spiritual and celestial things, which reasoners will not see.
To eat honey and butter () = what is celestial spiritual.
In the most ancient time they ate... butter, etc.
Butter () = the celestial of the Rational. Butter, in the Word = what is celestial, from its fatness. Illustrated.
Butter and honey shall He eat... Butter = His Celestial; and honey, that which is from the Celestial. AC 5620:2.
Milk () = spiritual good; butter, celestial good; and honey, the happiness thence derived. AC 5620:3.
Butter of the herd () = what is celestial natural.
That the spiritual are averse to butter. SE 1162. SE 3894.
The butter and honey which He shall eat = the goods of love; butter, the good of celestial and spiritual love; honey, the good of natural love.
Butter of the herd, and milk of the flock = the good of truth external and internal.
Butters () = the good of external affection; oil, the good of internal affection.
The appropriation of Divine good spiritual and natural as to the Human is meant by butter and honey shall He eat; Divine good spiritual by butter, and Divine good natural by honey.
Butter and honey shall everyone eat that is left in the land... Butter and honey = spiritual good and natural good.

Butter and honey shall He eat... Butter = the delight of spiritual good; and honey the delight of natural good; thus the Divine Spiritual and the Divine Natural; thus His Human interiorly and exteriorly. AE 619:5.
